boundaries: An existing explicit role owner is never overwritten by a native creator observation.
A creator without a verified website binding remains pending_creator.
TianYi needs actual native registry or online NumenOwner evidence; an old same-name player file is not proof.
Invalid optional Numen evidence cannot block account jobs, password receipts or authentication heartbeats.
No new live viewer source, mobile/Xbox pixel verification or sixteen-model long-duration load test.

rollback.programs: Restore the retained previous website container and the exact five home-publisher preimages through the original wrappers.
rollback.data: Keep the latest portal database, credentials, bindings and audit history. Older programs ignore the two additional Numen tables; do not overwrite newer user data with the backup.
